name: Al Qayyoom
description: Allah exists without dependence on another, while all creation depends on Him for its existence and continuance.
summary: Al Qayyoom expresses both self-subsistence and the sustaining of all creation. Allah needs no other to uphold Him, while everything else depends on Him. It appears with Al Haiyy in Quran 2:255, 3:2 and 20:111.
